paragraphs: Registered in July 2026 with 5 million RMB capital, Guangdong Duifei Trading Co., Ltd. is located at No.19 Jubao Road, Tangtang Town, Fogang County, Qingyuan, Guangdong. We hold Unified Social Credit Code 91441821MAKJP1EU4A.
